# Results 2.2 Notebooks

Notebooks for analysis of control (fibroblasts) and reprogrammed cells. h5ad file used for analysis was built in `Hematokytos/anndatas/integrate_scfib_ihsc.ipynb`.

## Notebooks
- `RTqPCR.ipynb` – Analysis of RTqPCR results (Figure 2B)
- `flow_data.ipynb` – Analysis of flow cytometry results (Figure 2C)
- `spike_ins.ipynb` – Identification and analysis of library 1 spike-in controls (Figure S11)
- `gene_expression.ipynb` – Marker gene expression (Figure 2F-I, S12)
- `DEG.ipynb` – Differential gene expression analysis (Figure 2J-K)
